title: Unique Loom Barista Collection Area Rug - Kouillou (2' 2" x 3' 1" Oval, Multi/Brown)
features: PILE MATERIAL: 100% Polypropylene; CONSTRUCTION: Machine Made in Turkey

CARE: When vacuuming, use without a beater bar or set the bar to the highest pile setting and use a low power setting. Spot clean stains immediately with a mild detergent, rinse thoroughly and blot dry. Rotate for even wear.
RUG PAD: We encourage the purchase of a rug pad if placement on a hard surface such as wood or tile flooring. Rug pads are also used for additional under the foot comfort. Rug pad sold separately.
RESISTANT: Stands up against stains, shedding and fading with proper care

SHIPPING: Rug will arrive factory rolled/folded and may have creases from packaging & compression from storage, normally flattening within 3-7 days. Reduce/remove creases by rolling the rug, pattern side up, & massaging the creases with your hands.
